Gemini 4 Hydrogen just joined Copilot. Here's a seven-slide test worth keeping.

WHAT CHANGED
GitHub announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on November 13, including Copilot CLI. Rollout is gradual; plan and organization policies affect access.

WHAT IT DOES
It's designed for fast agentic coding, tool use and multistep workflows. That means working through a task with tools, not only writing an answer.

BUILDER VALUE
Another model in your existing workspace is a chance to test a repeatable job without rebuilding your stack. It is not proof that every job gets better.

TRY THIS
In a disposable repo with no secrets, choose one small reproducible bug. Record the expected result and existing test command. Give Hydrogen that brief with approval required for tool actions. Inspect the diff, run the test, and note time, cost and corrections. If comparing models, use a fresh copy of the same starting point.

THE SIGNAL
AI is moving into work surfaces. Acceptance criteria need to move with it.

Our latest Tech Thursday supplied the reminder: Copilot CLI generated images through MCP, but the host rejected the look. Different tool task, same need to review the result.

Save this for your next AI model test.
